minimum_evidence: role-specific first-receiver training completion and exercise observation
PPE selection basis for radiological contamination and concurrent hazards
donning/doffing observation and breach correction log
pregnant worker assignment and exposure management policy
replacement staffing when worker reaches limit or fatigue threshold
respiratory protection/fit/medical clearance path if applicable
security/crowd-control staff PPE and dose controls
training freshness and just-in-time refresher proof
CAP/retest/verifier if PPE or dose-control defect observed
